info.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace - INSTAMART
info.description: Instamart vertical: stores, catalog (categories/subcategories/products), inventory and Instamart orders. There is no separate Instamart-vendor login — Store, catalog and inventory management are entirely admin-driven.

item.name: Admin Auth
item.description: Instamart has no vendor-facing login of its own (see store.routes.ts) — every endpoint below is admin-only. Log in here first to populate {{adminToken}}.

item.name: Orders (Instamart)
item.description: Generic order endpoints, filtered/exercised here in an INSTAMART (businessType=INSTAMART) context. There is no Instamart-vendor actor, so these all use {{adminToken}}. Order creation is customer-only and out of scope for this collection.
